name: StaticAdmin
description: Back up every project's Static data to one ZIP, or restore it back.
author: f-steff

inputs.name: mode
inputs.label: Action
inputs.helpMarkDown: Backup reads every selected project's Static data into one ZIP; restore writes a ZIP back (replacing each project's data).

inputs.name: backupPath
inputs.label: ZIP file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Backup: where to write the archive (e.g. $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/static-backup.zip). Restore: the archive to read.

inputs.name: artifactName
inputs.label: Artifact name (backup only)
inputs.helpMarkDown: When set, the archive is also attached to the build as a pipeline artifact with this name.

inputs.name: projects
inputs.label: Projects (optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comma-separated project names or ids to include. Leave empty for every project.

inputs.name: accessToken
inputs.label: Access token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Requires 'Allow scripts to access the OAuth token' on the pipeline.
